question: The European Border and Coast Guard Agency (Frontex) is looking into using high-altitude pseudosatellites (HAPS). As noted by the defence contractor Airbus, it has been receiving images from the test platform Zephyr. 1.
Which research projects on the development or use of HAPS is Frontex involved in and how much has it contributed to them?
Which HAPS projects has Frontex received images from, and in connection with which other projects is this planned?
What other stratosphere surveillance services does Frontex plan to look into or make accessible, and under which projects?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (19.6.2024) As the question regarding ‘Frontex’s involvement in high-altitude platforms’ falls entirely under the responsibility of the European Border and Coast Guard Agency (Frontex), the Commission has asked the Agency to provide the details requested by the Honourable Member. The Agency’s reply will be sent by the Commission to the Honourable Member as soon as possible.
